detail.longDescription: Hey yall, so I've kinda started understanding why people tend to hate on AI, I found myself in a situation where I would stop thinking myself, I stopped evaluating whether my issue could be fixed by just using my damn brain. So I just wanted to stop for a few months, just see what will happen. Tho my biggest issue now: I am a Full-Stack Dev and of course I could again write my code 100% myself, tho using Tools like Claude for writing pipelines tests or even features you are to lazy to do yourself is pretty cool, cant lie about that one. Now I'm asking myself the ethical question whether its fine using AI in that field because I still "boycott"/stop using AI in other fields.. What are yalls thoughts on this one?
